body:
Here's a story... a team called EDG (Edwards Group), possibly the same one mentioned above, won world of warcraft, 200m live viewers, a lot of people bought EDG (Edgeware) crypto currency thinking that it was somehow related, and the price of EDG went up 300%! I was there when it happened. 100 Chinese people came into the Edgeware telegram asking "what the heck is this cryptocurrency?" in chinese. That's why we have an Edgeware Chinese Channel.  What if there was an actual serious considered approach to this, and the next team that wins one of these things was actually related to Edgeware? This proposal is the beginning of something...

I really like the idea of Edgeware creating and hosting guaranteed prize pool tournaments for selected games. 

Free to play tournaments, as well as buy in tournaments. 
Just like poker tournaments , people and teams could also buy in to the tournament (in EDG) to participate in the competition. 

This can be done across different games attracting various communities to Edgeware. People or teams, will be attracted by the guarantee in the prize pool, it will attract pros, amateurs and their followings. 

Would be great to tap into twitch based gamers and their followings too. 

Since the serendipitous tripling of EDG price last year because of EDG winning world of warcraft, i think there is so much value here that can be tapped in to.
